location.ref: Āgamasāra, on the hidden abode within the body

paraphrase: The eternal Vṛndāvana is within the body: its lakes and lotuses are there, and the divine couple sport there; the outer Vṛndāvana is its image.
translation_basis: paraphrase from memory of the vernacular text (Phase B skeleton); to be checked against an edition in Phase D
notes: Skeleton from memory (Phase B). Gist attributed with low confidence to this text.
